decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Time clocks shall be fitted to the advertisement hereby approved so that it shall be non-illuminated between the hours of 20:00hrs and 07:00hrs.
Condition : 2 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 3 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission
Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - The sign must not have any intermittent light sources, animation, moving feature or exposed cold cathode tubing.

Condition : 7 - The footway and carriageway on Staines Road must not be blocked during the installation and maintenance of the sign.  Temporary obstruction during the installation must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrian, or obstruct the flow of traffic.
description: Erection of an internally illuminated double sided freestanding totem sign with eight tenant signs
